title: The Green Children of Woolpit
hook: What secret lies behind the green children of Woolpit?
headline: Mystery of the Green Children

beats.label: THE CASE
beats.line: In 12th-century Woolpit, two siblings emerged from a mysterious underground pit.

beats.label: CLUE 1
beats.line: Chronicles by Ralph of Coggeshall note the children's skin was a faint emerald hue.

beats.label: CLUE 2
beats.line: The siblings spoke an unknown language until they learned English from villagers in 1150.

beats.label: THE TWIST
beats.line: Modern analysis suggests the children may have suffered from a rare chlorosis condition, yet no conclusive proof exists.

end.line: Could a hidden disease explain the green mystery?

description: Explore the medieval mystery of Woolpit's green children in under 30 seconds.
